{{Quote|I am Marles Jacobe of the ''Corellia Times''. I am investigating the military buildup here in Restuss. It has already caused the entire city to be evacuated, displacing thousands of families. And with tensions running high there is sure to be a showdown. What are your thoughts on this whole situation?|Marles Jacobe to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SK">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
'''Marles Jacobe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] reporter for the ''[[Corellia Times]]'' who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Jacobe investigated the brewing [[Battle of Restuss]] by questioning [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who passed through the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Restuss refugee camp|refugee area]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Marles Jacobe was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
